dimensions.definition_quote: describes transformations applied to a text after an initial version already exists
value_list_verbatim: F4: global rhetorical or structural restructuring.
dimensions.quote: For this reason, the Form facet is defined as a scale of increasing textual transformation.

dimensions.definition_quote: describes how a text segment came into existence
value_list_verbatim: G2: AI-generated with a simple prompt.
G3: AI-generated with a detailed prompt.
G5: AI-generated through a structured multi-step conversational or computational pipeline.
dimensions.quote: The Generation facet describes how a text segment came into existence.

dimensions.definition_quote: describes how the resulting text was reviewed, checked, or validated
dimensions.quote: The Evaluation facet describes how the resulting text was reviewed, checked, or validated.

value_list_verbatim: I0: no AI intent or unspecified use.
I3: generation of new textual content.
I4: conceptual support, ideation, framing, or argument development.
dimensions.quote: The Intent facet describes why AI was used.

dimensions.definition_quote: describes who directed the production process
value_list_verbatim: C1: AI used under narrow constraints.
C3: AI-dominant production with human selection or approval.
dimensions.quote: The Control facet describes who directed the production process.

dimensions.definition_quote: describes whether the production process can be reconstructed
value_list_verbatim: T3: full logs, model identification, and intermediate versions available.
dimensions.quote: The Traceability facet describes whether the production process can be reconstructed.

dimensions.definition_quote:
Fidelity refers to how closely the system emulates the sub­
ject’s voice, personality, or worldview; disclosure 
concerns 
whether its artificial nature is clearly signaled.
dimensions.quote:
A system may be high-fidelity yet ethically acceptable if accompanied by persistent and 
unambiguous disclosure, or low-fidelity yet misleading
